stemMd: Which event normally occurs in the uterine tube rather than the uterus?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Implantation of the embryo in the endometrium

options.label: C
options.textMd: Shedding of the endometrium during menstruation

explanationMd: Fertilization normally occurs in a uterine tube, commonly its ampulla. The resulting early embryo travels toward the uterus, where implantation occurs later. Distinguishing the site of fertilization from the site of implantation resolves the question.

distractorRationale.b: Normal implantation occurs in the uterine lining.
distractorRationale.a: The fetus normally develops in the uterus.
distractorRationale.c: The endometrium is the uterine lining.
distractorRationale.e: Sperm are produced in the testes.
